material.description: NASA Science, “Chapter 1: The Solar System”, “Distances Within the Solar System” and “Light Time” passages (https://science.nasa.gov/learn/basics-of-space-flight/chapter1-1/): the chapter identifies the astronomical unit as the mean Earth–Sun distance and gives light-time/light-year scales for larger distances. This supports the Claim’s use of distinct distance scales; an astronomical unit and a light-year are not interchangeable units.
